note: Every enumerated column in registry.json names one of these sets. A value outside its set fails decode before any SQLite write.

boolean.source: Integer truth column; SQLite has no boolean type.

origin.source: src/contracts/operatorSession.ts SessionOrigin and docs/spec/operator-session.md 7 (session identity); reconciled against the accepted CA-15 producer (merge cd8e8bd). Forkness is carried by parent_operator_session_id, not by origin.

turnState.source: src/contracts/operatorSession.ts TurnState, reconciled against the accepted CA-15 producer (merge cd8e8bd); docs/spec/operator-session.md 8.3 turn record, including the interrupted, failed, and cancelled turns that section requires to remain journaled.

refType.source: CA-16 work brief session_pins.ref_type, matching the explicit include options in docs/spec/operator-session.md 10.1.

proposalType.source: docs/spec/operator-session.md 15.2 minimum effect set requiring confirmation.

capsuleOmission.source: docs/spec/operator-session.md 10.2 exclusions, reported so a truncated or withheld field is never mistaken for absence of the fact.

reconciliation.note: origin and turnState differ from the CORRECTION-03 design artifact. An index that enumerated the design values could not admit a single real operator session.
